description: Held-out answers written AFTER the claim-check heuristics were frozen. Never used for tuning; run once and report as is. Includes subtle faults the heuristics are not designed to catch (swapped roles, flipped conditions, swapped numbers, small unit changes).

cases.answer: A buddy is assigned to each new joiner for their first 30 days [1].
Security and compliance training must be finished within 7 days of joining [1].
Harassment, discrimination and bullying are not tolerated, and can lead to disciplinary action up to termination [1].
You can report wrongdoing through the ethics hotline, Compliance or a senior manager, and reports can be anonymous [1].
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the trip via the finance portal [1]. Claims older than 60 days are rejected [1].
Remote staff need to be reachable between 10:00 and 16:00 local time [1].
When working outside the office, use the company VPN and multi-factor authentication [1]. Customer data must not be handled over public Wi-Fi without the VPN [1].
Training and conference costs go to cost centre 4410, and recruitment agency fees to cost centre 5120 [1].
Policy code PRV-3 covers retention of customer records [1].
Use the Report Phishing button to flag suspicious emails [1].
Every P1 incident gets a post-incident review within 5 working days [1].
Submit your self-assessment at least 7 days before the review, and managers gather feedback from at least 3 peers [1].
HR runs calibration sessions to keep ratings consistent across teams, and final ratings reach employees within 10 working days [1].
Someone rated 1 or 2 may be put on a 60-day improvement plan with weekly check-ins [1].
Confidential counselling is available around the clock at no cost to employees and their families [1].
You get a 30 USD monthly wellness stipend for gym or fitness apps, and an annual health check is fully covered [1].
Customers can ask for access to or deletion of their personal data, and we must respond within 30 days [1].
Personal data can be shared only with approved vendors who have signed a data processing agreement [1].
Multi-factor authentication is required on every company system, and you must never share your credentials, even with IT [1].
Primary caregivers are entitled to 16 weeks of paid parental leave [1].
Your HR team approves or declines the leave request within 2 working days [1].
The standard probation period is 90 weeks [1].
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week before completing probation [1].
Business class requires VP approval for flights shorter than 6 hours [1].
Report a suspected breach to the Compliance team within 24 hours [1].
The company matches retirement contributions up to 5 percent of base salary from day one [1].
Employees who lose a company laptop must pay for its replacement [1].
P3 incidents are handled within 2 hours [1].
Customers may request deletion of their personal data [1].
Unused annual leave expires at the end of each calendar year with no carry forward [1].
Compliance acknowledges every report within 3 working days and informs the CEO of each case [1].
Employees must never accept gifts from vendors [1].
The learning budget is 1,500 USD per calendar year [1].
Reviews are held three times a year, in March, June and December [1].
Form IT-88 is used to request parental leave [1].
P1 incidents require a response within 4 hours and P2 incidents within 15 minutes [1].
Managers approve the remote schedule, except for employees in the Sales department [1].
Personal data is deleted after 24 months, and a copy is archived for legal purposes [1].
Switch the affected device off immediately so that evidence is preserved [1].
Report lost devices within 1 day of discovery [1].
